1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri Rajesh Kumar Dubey, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Birendra Pratap Singh,
learned counsel for the State and perused the record.
3.
The present application under Sections 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Ankit with the following prayers:

"It is, therefore most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble court may graciously be pleased to allow the instant application and may quash the order dated 04.07.2022/03.03.2023 by which Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gautam Buddha Nagar Ankit vs State Of Upand Another on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109908551/
1 issued Non- Bailable Warrant/proceedings under Section 82 Cr.P.C.,
Cognizance/Summoning order dated 16.02.2021, charge-sheet dated 11.11.2020 as well as entire criminal proceeding of the Criminal Case No. 3488 of 2021 (State Vs.
Ankit) under Section 376 of I.P.C., Police Station Phase-III, District Gautam Buddha Nagar, arising out of Case Crime No. 0087 of 2020, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gautam Buddha Nagar.
It is further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to stay the further proceeding of the the order dated 04.07.2022/03.03.2023 by which Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gautam Buddha Nagar issued Non-Bailable Warrant/ proceedings under Section 82 Cr.P.C., Cognizance/Summoning order dated 16.02.2021, charge-sheet dated 11.11.2020 as well as entire criminal proceeding of the Criminal Case No. 3488 of 2021 (State Vs. Ankit) under Section 376 of I.P.C., Police Station Phase-III, District Gautam Buddha Nagar, arising out of Case Crime No. 0087 of 2020, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gautam Buddha Nagar, otherwise the applicants shall suffer irreparable loss and injury.

sentences.text:
And/or may pass such other and further order as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case."
4. After arguments at length, learned counsel for the applicant submits that he does not press the prayers made in the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. and submits that liberty may be granted to him to seek discharge in the present case.

5. Needless to state that if an accused-applicant claims discharge at the appropriate stage, the trial court shall consider the same in accordance with law.
6. The present application is disposed of.
Order Date :- 16.5.2024 M. ARIF (Samit Gopal, J.)
